note: P0/P1/P2 are positive controls. Without them the A controls would be satisfied by a harness that refuses everything, which catches nothing because it decides nothing.

controls.description: the mock, told to behave, really does move every mode to expected_post -- otherwise every A control below passes for the wrong reason
the shared classifier returns PROVEN for clean observations from the real backend -- so its refusals are informative rather than constant
the SAME clean observations attributed to the mock backend yield MOCK_ONLY, which is absent from RESULTS_COUNTING_AS_PROOF

controls.maps_to: 1. installer reports success but the slot is unchanged
controls.description: installation reports success while every mode still observes the old implementation

controls.maps_to: 2. direct call changes but virtual dispatch stays old
controls.description: the defining bypass of #62 I2: one dispatch form follows the patch and another does not
the same bypass through an interface-typed receiver

controls.maps_to: 3. only new tear-offs change; a pre-patch tear-off is old
controls.description: a tear-off captured before installation keeps reaching the old implementation while everything else moves
the cold path follows the patch and the hot, specialised one does not -- invisible to any cold-only harness

controls.maps_to: 5. stale prior evidence after a failed current run
controls.description: a row record that this run did not stamp is INCOMPLETE, not an answer carried over from last time

controls.maps_to: 6. one matrix row deleted from the run
controls.description: not running a row is not a way to finish it

controls.maps_to: 7. a high percentage with one in-scope row unproven
controls.description: 99.04% of rows proven is still NOT_PROVEN, while the same shape with nothing short does reach PROVEN -- so the refusal is the conjunction, not an inability to pass
a patch not bound to the release it targets is refused even when every observed value looks right

controls.maps_to: 9. a process restart would make the test appear to pass
controls.description: every observed value is exactly expected_post, and the run is still refused because the process identity changed

controls.maps_to: 9. the rebuilt-program baseline substituted for post
controls.description: patch_source_baseline is a NEW process; using it as the post observation is caught by the same nonce check

controls.maps_to: 10. a value is computed but consumed by no decision
controls.description: every field the aggregate produces names the decision that reads it, checked in both directions
